name: Gwynant Solitaire
subtitle: Klondike and more, no ads
promotionalText: Seven classic patience games on one calm table: Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Yukon, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Golf. No ads, ever.
description:
Classic patience on a calm, uncluttered table.

SEVEN GAMES
• Klondike, with one-card or three-card draws
• FreeCell
• Spider, with one, two or four suits
• Yukon
• Pyramid
• TriPeaks
• Golf

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Large, clear cards that are easy to read on any screen
• Double-tap a card to send it home, or drag it where you like
• Unlimited undo

CALM BY DESIGN
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking. Ever.
• Light and dark themes that follow your device
• Soft, optional sounds and gentle haptics
• Your game is saved the moment you leave

Gwynant games are free and open source, made with care in the spirit of Llyn Gwynant: quiet, simple and unhurried.
